license_note: No license file at pinned revision. Fetch source/assets separately; none redistributed in this project.
local_adapter: Replace stock Panda finger geometry/inertia with the complete source mountable housing using a rigid pose transform and names/collision-bit mapping; retain original hand and finger slide joints. Original geometry, masses, source contact settings and optical factory constants preserved. Native MuJoCo RGB-pass depth readback replaces mujoco_py; raw OpenGL buffer feeds untouched Phong driver. Metre depth reported separately. Original Newton/100/no-noslip retained for this hardware. No material FEM or hardware calibration claim. Sensor-camera metric clipping planes are read from the compiled pinned PickAndPlace scene and applied only to the offscreen camera, preserving FOV and raw-depth calibration independently of host scene extent. Legacy-engine end-to-end parity is not yet established. Host physics options are fully replaced by source options, retaining the local 0.5 ms runner step. The standalone six-axis diagnostic probe additionally uses implicitfast instead of source Euler because of its local servo/inertia. Housing long axis now follows the Panda finger; mounting is unverified and is not the Isaac GelSight Mini custom-finger assembly. Fixed metric diagnostic baseline rendered from the isolated unloaded source module, never from current loaded task state.
task_integration: Selectable alone in all Panda tasks; shared keyboard/SpaceMouse/Pico software and LeRobot recording. Elastic clip tasks explicitly use MuJoCo discrete spring integration; source sensor contact settings/optical functions unchanged. Other tasks retain source integration. Diagnostic six-axis probe uses critical translational damping for its 20 g/3000 N/m servo, not a changed sensor material.
